description: productops.code_edit: anchored edits to one existing file, or the whole contents of one new file, inside the approved plan. The expectation pins the kind and the path; an edit to an existing file must be anchored, never whole-file.

input.instruction: In packages/domain/src/plans.ts the Free plan's knowledgeSnippets is 3. Change it to 4. The line reads exactly: knowledgeSnippets: 3,

reference.rationale: The Free plan gets one more retrieved snippet per turn, per the approved plan.

input.instruction: Create apps/learner/tests/unit/review/grammar-card.test.tsx with a Vitest test that renders GrammarCard from @/components/review/grammar-card with example 'Heute ich gehe' and corrected 'Heute gehe ich' and asserts both strings are visible.

reference.rationale: The test the plan lists before the component exists.
